changelog.summary: Photo notes: camera or library from the capture bar (several at once), shrunk and re-saved on the phone without hidden metadata, thumbnails sized to the ruled lines, full-screen view with pinch/double-tap zoom, swipe between photos and Save via the share sheet, optional captions, delete with undo, photos included in encrypted backups and restore. Schema v2 adds a media store (additive migration from v1).

Foundation: install screen, ruled day pages with timestamped notes, quick capture, edit and delete with undo, day flipping, date picker, offline service worker with update prompt, persistent storage request, CSP lockdown, encrypted backup and restore.

knownIssues: Tested in headless Chromium only; not yet confirmed on a real iPhone (Safari/WebKit).
The quick-capture bar lifts above the iOS keyboard using visualViewport; behaviour on the real keyboard is unverified.
Backups use the iOS share sheet (Save to Files); the download fallback is untested on iOS.
Backups are built in memory in one piece; with many hundreds of photos this may hit iPhone memory limits. Chunked backups may be needed later.
Photo picking, camera capture, HEIC handling and pinch zoom are untested on a real iPhone.
nextUp: Stage 3: find anything (full-text search across notes and photo captions, results grouped by day with highlighted matches, plus On this day).
